title: Entity Scaffold Spec
description: What a model fills in from intent, and what the generator consumes. The split matters: a small local model is reliable at turning 'track invoices with a number, amount, and due date' into this object, and unreliable at emitting correct C# across four files. Filling a validated spec is a task it can be checked on; generating code is not.

name.description: PascalCase class name, singular: Invoice, not invoices or InvoiceEntity.

resource.description: Policy table key the model is governed by. Must already exist in .pmcro/policies/resource-operations.json, or the generated repository is denied at runtime - which is the correct failure, but a confusing one to meet by surprise.

summary.description: One sentence a person who was not here would understand.

naturalKey.description: Property holding the meaningful id, when the model has one beyond the surrogate Guid: FrameId, ConstraintId, InvoiceNumber.

namedOnUnitOfWork.description: Add a typed property to IUnitOfWork. Leave false unless callers keep reaching for this type; Repository<T>() already works without it.

type.description: Deliberately a closed list. An open type field invites a model to invent a type that does not compile, and the generator cannot tell the difference until build time.
